study: Seed-variability study for the three architecture configurations (validation only)
declared: 2026-10-04, before any new run in this study
purpose: Quantify run-to-run (seed) variability before adding architectures; decide whether architecture differences exceed seed noise.
only_change: random seed (and run name / output directories)
analysis: per architecture: macro F1 for each seed, mean, SD, min/max; balanced accuracy and accuracy; per-class F1 mean +/- SD; best-epoch distribution
seed-paired architecture differences, compared with within-architecture seed SD
if no convincing winner: recommend the simplest model within the noise range, not the highest single score
rules: exactly 6 new runs; no additional runs added based on results
test split never loaded or evaluated

decision_rule.recorded: 2026-10-04T15:12:03 (local), while the first new run was training and before any new result was inspected
decision_rule.pooled_seed_sd: sqrt(mean over architectures of the sample variance (ddof=1) of best-epoch validation macro F1 across the 3 seeds)
decision_rule.convincing_winner: an architecture whose seed-paired macro-F1 difference vs EACH other architecture is positive for all 3 seeds AND whose mean paired advantage exceeds the pooled seed SD
decision_rule.otherwise: no convincing winner: recommend the simplest architecture whose mean macro F1 is within one pooled seed SD of the best mean
simplicity_order: baseline_cnn (294,740 params, from scratch, no recurrence)
